The '''''Reckoning''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Granakk]]. Its hull was stronger than a stock YT-1300, and it was upgraded with heavy [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and an [[assault laser cannon]], which replaced the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on the standard [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] model.
